note: Pinned build manifest for the Draw.io icon packs. Every source carries an exact version or a recorded sha256, so `build-packs.mjs --verify` can prove the committed libraries match it.

simple-icons.note: The icons are CC0. The trademarks they depict are not.

simple-icons-15.note: On-demand only. These marks were removed in 16.x at the brand owners request, so no bytes ship here.

azure-v24.permission: Copy, distribute and display for architecture diagrams only. Icon shape must not be altered. All other rights reserved by Microsoft.

gcp-core.permission: Free to use to reference Google Cloud technology. Trademarks remain Google property.

gcp-legacy.note: Google now publishes per-service marks only as a legacy archive. On a title collision the 19 current core-product icons win.
